Summary: SMB support SaaS building agent-assist and automated triage. Primary ask: hosted API self-serve POC to extract structured fields from incoming tickets, generate concise summaries for agents, and support tool-calls to update ticket status in their system. Latency tolerance: 200-400ms typical per request; peak 20 req/s during small bursts. Cost sensitive but prefers pay-as-you-go; likely to stay hosted unless strict residency needed. Model preferences: open-model compatibility, deterministic structured outputs (JSON schema), low hallucination on fields (customer, product, priority).

Recent call highlights:
- "If we can get reliable summaries and structured fields for our ticket flows, we can reduce agent handle time by ~25%" (Lena).
- Engineering wants example tool-calling payloads for changing ticket status and adding internal notes.
- Security: must see SOC2 report and SSO/SAML notes before approving anything for staging.

POC scope agreed: 2-week hosted-api trial integrating ticket ingest -> summary + structured fields -> tool-call to create/update ticket. Success metrics: summary accuracy >= 85% on 3 prompt sets; field extraction F1 >= 80%; end-to-end latency < 500ms 90th pct.
